title: OrderReservationMessage
description: Body of a message on the order-reservation queue: asks the workers to reserve (or issue as complimentary) the tickets of a QUEUED order. Message attributes: messageType=ORDER_RESERVATION_REQUESTED, correlationId, schemaVersion=1. Consumers are idempotent (at-least-once delivery).

orderId.description: Order identifier (UUID v5 derived from the requester and the idempotency key).

correlationId.description: Correlation id of the original HTTP request.

occurredAt.description: ISO-8601 instant at which the message was produced.
